info.title: Mahfel API
info.description: Control-plane REST API. Requests are authenticated with a Keycloak access token that the API verifies as a resource server (ADR 0019).

201.description: Service principal created; api_key is shown once

404.description: Service principal not found

200.description: New api_key shown once; previous keys revoked

404.description: Service principal not found

get.summary: Current application profile, resolved from the token without a database read.

post.summary: Provision (or resolve) the local user and link it in Keycloak.
post.description:
The frontend calls this once after login. The first call for an unseen
`(issuer, subject)` creates the user; later calls refresh provider fields.
The local user id is written onto the Keycloak user so subsequent tokens
carry `app_user_id`. Identity is never linked by email.

A code is a bearer capability, so every unusable code returns the same
`404`, and attempts are rate-limited per principal and source address. The
code is carried in the body rather than the path: a path segment would be
recorded by access logs and `Referer` headers, which defeats the log hygiene
ADR 0021 requires.

404.description: Code is unknown, expired, revoked, or the rate limit was reached

409.description: The target's lobby is at capacity

post.summary: Revoke an invite link. Revocation is terminal.
post.description:
Manager-only, authorized against the link's own target, so a manager can only
revoke links belonging to a room they manage. A repeat revoke is a `409`.

404.description: Link does not exist or its target is not managed by the caller

post.summary: Rotate an invite link: retire the current code and issue a replacement.
post.description:
Both happen in one transaction, so no client ever observes two live codes or
none. The previous row is retained so the history shows what was retired.

404.description: Link does not exist or its target is not managed by the caller

422.description: Requested expiry is out of range

post.summary: Manager-only: replace an interval with a corrected one.
post.description:
The original row is retained as superseded, so the original measurement and
the reason it changed both survive.

409.description: Interval already superseded or the correction is invalid

get.description:
Username is `<expiry>:<user_id>` where expiry is Unix timestamp.
Password is `base64(hmac_sha1(secret, username))`.
Valid for `turn.ttl_seconds` (default 300s). Requires `Authenticated`.

user_id.description: Identifier (UUID) of the user to add.

AdmissionPolicyDto.description:
Transport-level admission schema. Kept out of the domain so `utoipa` never
reaches `mahfel-domain` (ADR 0015).

ended_at.description:
End of the replacement interval, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Omit to
record the participant as still connected.

started_at.description: Start of the replacement interval, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

CorrectionReasonDto.description:
Transport-level correction reason. Kept out of the domain so `utoipa` never
reaches `mahfel-domain` (ADR 0015).

scheduled_start_at.description: Optional advisory start instant. A session may also be ad-hoc.

api_key.description: Raw API key, returned exactly once and never stored in the clear.

EchoPayload.description: Placeholder payload used by contract tests until real resource routes land.

connected_seconds.description:
Connected seconds this interval contributes, or the elapsed time when it
is still open and no session end has stopped the clock.

superseded_by.description: Present when a correction replaced this interval. The row is retained.

InviteLinkResponse.description: A link's code is not a secret to its manager, but it is never logged.

display_code.description: The `xxx-yyyy-zzz` form meant to be shown or copied.

redeemable.description: Derived from status and expiry; the server remains authoritative.

InviteTargetKindDto.description:
`utoipa` never reaches `mahfel-domain` (ADR 0015), so the domain's tagged
target enum becomes an explicit kind plus id here.

items.description: Placeholder payload used by contract tests until real resource routes land.

intervals.description: Every interval, including superseded ones, so a reader sees the history.

corrected_intervals.description: Intervals replaced by a correction, so a reader knows the total changed.

ProfileResponse.description: Application profile for the authenticated user.

code.description: The code as typed or pasted. Case and separators are ignored.

request_id.description: Present while waiting, so the client can poll its state.

RoomRoleDto.description:
Transport-level role schema. Kept out of the domain so `utoipa` never
reaches `mahfel-domain` (ADR 0015).

RoomVisibilityDto.description:
Transport-level visibility schema. Kept out of the domain so `utoipa`
never reaches `mahfel-domain` (ADR 0015).

expiry_days.description: Omit to preserve the previous link's window rather than resetting it.

api_key.description: New raw API key, returned exactly once and never stored in the clear.

visibility.description: The value that governs this session, after inheritance.

visibility_overridden.description: Whether each axis is overridden rather than inherited from the room.

capabilities.description:
Capability names the caller holds in the session's room. Absent means
denied, so an empty list is a complete answer.

oneOf.description: `None` means the session inherits its room's value.

SessionStatusDto.description:
Transport-level session status schema. Kept out of the domain so `utoipa`
never reaches `mahfel-domain` (ADR 0015).

SessionVisibilityDto.description: Transport-level visibility schema for a session override.

oneOf.description: Omit to clear an override and inherit the room's value again.
